subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Our closest neighbour India is the largest country in South Asia and the (a) ------- largest in the world. It shares borders with countries like Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar. India is also the second most (b) ------- country in the world, with a population of over one billion. The civilization of India began with the Indus Valley and flourished under the Aryans. Later, rulers like Emperor Ashoka promoted Buddhism. Islam arrived in the 8th century and led to the formation of the (c) ------- Sultanate in 1206. The Mughal Empire later brought political unity. India was ruled by the British for nearly two centuries before gaining independence in 1947. The country is rich in cultural diversity, with 17 major languages and hundreds of (d) ------- spoken across regions. Famous tourist sites like the Taj Mahal, Red Fort, and Kashmir attract visitors worldwide. With its mountains, rivers, and temples, India offers a (e) ------- of natural and historical wonders. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) seventh; (b) populous; (c) Delhi; (d) dialects; (e) variety; ● ●
